propositions: Core must compare only canonical local-vocabulary shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads at port boundaries (InboundMapper/OutboundMapper).
All vendor-specific modules (acli, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits, probe) must be physically relocated into adapters/jira/ with no re-export shims or core reach-through.
Backend selection and transport construction must route exclusively through the port interface; all provider literals and by-path vendor loads in package-root core modules must be eliminated.
Outbound differ, link differ, absence probe, and rich-text/comment-limit code paths must achieve canonical comparison parity with inbound_differ.py:159 design.
Zero direct import of adapters.jira or lazy-key literals (except inbound_fields.py) permitted in src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*.py; verified by backend-neutrality tests.
